research_brief.question: Can a three-layer, uncertainty-aware reachability model distinguish physical-stability limits from technology/evidence limits beyond element 118?
research_brief.hypothesis: The model is better calibrated on time-split historical outcomes than stability-only and scenario-only baselines.
research_brief.scientific_object: Versioned public-record corpus and model/evidence representations.
alternative_explanations: Historical source labels are too sparse or inconsistent.
Theory disagreement overwhelms any technology/evidence contribution.
Observed outcomes reflect unmeasured institutional/resource factors.
The evidence schema encodes modern knowledge into historical records.

primary_endpoint: Time-split calibration of later documented record states with declared abstention policy.
needs_human_input: Historical time cutoffs and record-state codebook.
Expert-approved evidence graph and governance wording.
